title: Home Page

fields.label: Your bio — first paragraph
fields.name: bio_paragraph_1
fields.instructions: Opens your Liner Notes on the home page and “The Story” on the Press Kit page. The first letter becomes the big decorative capital.

fields.label: Your bio — second paragraph
fields.name: bio_paragraph_2
fields.instructions: Middle of your bio. Mention releases by name and year — they read like liner notes.

fields.label: Your bio — third paragraph
fields.name: bio_paragraph_3
fields.instructions: Closes your bio (the volunteering paragraph today).

fields.label: Pull quote
fields.name: pull_quote
fields.instructions: The short quote in the pink-bordered block. Shown on Home and the Press Kit page. No quote marks needed — the site adds them.

fields.label: Quote credit
fields.name: pull_quote_attribution
fields.instructions: Who said it — shows as “~ Meghan Clarisse” today.

fields.label: Recognition timeline
fields.name: recognition
fields.instructions: Awards and memberships in the gold sidebar, newest first. Add a row per honor.

sub_fields.label: Detail
sub_fields.name: detail
sub_fields.instructions: The smaller line, e.g. “Album of the Year (Folk/Americana)”.

fields.label: Instagram caption
fields.name: instagram_caption
fields.instructions: The line under your Instagram grid (“Follow along between shows —”). Your handle is added after it automatically.

fields.label: Instagram handle
fields.name: instagram_handle
fields.instructions: Without the @. Changes the link and the @name shown.

fields.label: Mailing-list blurb
fields.name: newsletter_blurb
fields.instructions: The sentence under the headline — what people get and how often.

fields.label: Birthday note
fields.name: newsletter_birthday_note
fields.instructions: Shown under the birthday box on the signup form.

fields.label: Site photo
fields.name: hero_photo
fields.instructions: The big background photo used across the site. Replacing it changes every page — check with Levi before swapping.

fields.label: Facebook
fields.name: facebook_url
fields.instructions: The footer Facebook icon links here.

fields.label: Instagram
fields.name: instagram_url
fields.instructions: The footer Instagram icon links here.

fields.label: YouTube
fields.name: youtube_url
fields.instructions: The footer YouTube icon links here.

fields.label: Browser-tab title
fields.name: meta_title
fields.instructions: What Google and the browser tab show for the home page.

fields.label: Search description
fields.name: meta_description
fields.instructions: The sentence Google shows under your site name. One or two sentences.

fields.label: Blocks
fields.name: home_blocks
fields.instructions: Extra pieces for the Home page — an announcement, a quote, or a video. Add as many as you like, drag to reorder, remove them when they are old. They appear between the Instagram section and the press-kit teaser. Leave this empty and Home looks exactly as it does today.

sub_fields.label: Headline
sub_fields.name: headline
sub_fields.instructions: What people read first. Required — a block without a headline does not show.

sub_fields.label: Link text
sub_fields.name: link_label
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. e.g. “Listen now”. Needs a link address too.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: The quote itself, without quotation marks. Required.

sub_fields.label: YouTube link
sub_fields.name: youtube_url
sub_fields.instructions: Any YouTube link — watch, Shorts, or share. Required.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. One line under the video.

description: Everything editable on the megcmusic.com home page.
